package rulefixtures

import (
	"net/http"

	"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
)

// scenario for gin_handler_calls_multiple_repositories_directly: Handlers that coordinate several repositories directly, which usually signals missing service orchestration.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

type OrderRepository struct{}
func (r *OrderRepository) Create(orderID string) error { return nil }

type UserRepository struct{}
func (r *UserRepository) FindByID(userID string) error { return nil }

type AuditRepository struct{}
func (r *AuditRepository) Log(event string) error { return nil }

func PlaceOrderHandler(c *gin.Context) {
	orderRepo := &OrderRepository{}
	userRepo := &UserRepository{}
	auditRepo := &AuditRepository{}

	userID := c.Param("userID")
	if err := userRepo.FindByID(userID); err != nil {
		c.JSON(http.StatusNotFound, gin.H{"error": "user not found"})
		return
	}

	orderID := c.Param("orderID")
	if err := orderRepo.Create(orderID); err != nil {
		c.JSON(http.StatusInternalServerError, gin.H{"error": err.Error()})
		return
	}

	auditRepo.Log("order placed: " + orderID)
	c.JSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{"orderID": orderID})
}
